title: Gildenhall保费信托监控
instruction:
你是Gildenhall Freight的财务经理Petra Alcantara。Vellumstone Laboratories的承保授权业务自五月开展以来，其保费信托余额一直只在月末进行复核。Jarek Thackeray希望在春季检查前建立每日异常监控。难点在于：计划向保险公司汇出的款项完成清算时，信托账户余额会下降，但相应负债的解除可能稍后才记入记录。如果直接依据未经调整的账户余额设定规则，就会频繁产生常规误报，最终使团队不再认真对待警报。

请使用`premium_trust_dossier.xlsx`中的每日业务活动、业务增长假设、汇款计划及展望情景，并使用`control_notes_and_policy.docx`中的政策文本和流程操作人员的消息。不得援引这些附件以外的法律、费率或惯例。

建立`premium_trust_exception_monitor.xlsx`，其中的工作表必须命名为`Daily Monitor`、`Scenario Outlook`和`Method`。它应展示历史每日状况，区分仅由时间差造成的异常与真实资金缺口，明确可执行的阈值和警报规则，并针对档案中列明的每一种展望情景，将该规则推演至检查日期。必须明确说明如何处理来源字段缺失、存款入账时点，以及汇款与负债解除之间的时间差。如果材料支持不止一种解读，应有意识地选择一种并贯彻一致，而不是混用不同方法。

另外，为Jarek和Ruben Vanterpool编制不超过五页的`premium_trust_compliance_assessment.pdf`。总结控制设计、历史结果、预测结果、局限及建议采用的实施方案，并说明警报触发后应由谁响应。评估中的阈值、历史异常、情景数据和建议必须与工作簿一致。请严格使用上述文件名，将两个文件写入工作目录的顶层。

---

上述文件位于`references/`：

- `references/premium_trust_dossier.xlsx`——每日保费信托活动、汇款与负债时点记录、承保授权业务增长输入、营业日日历、检查日期及指定展望情景。
- `references/control_notes_and_policy.docx`——给定司法辖区的政策摘录，以及利益相关方就银行入账、负债解除、结算信息缺失、控制责任归属及报告要求发出的消息。

请将完成的成果写入**当前工作目录的顶层**，严格使用以下文件名：

- `premium_trust_exception_monitor.xlsx`——历史每日监控、前瞻性情景展望和成文的监控方法。（必须包含名为Daily Monitor、Scenario Outlook和Method的工作表；必须始终采用同一种已披露的解读，并保持对给定来源的可追溯性。）
- `premium_trust_compliance_assessment.pdf`——面向外部的合规评估及实施建议。（不超过五页；与工作簿共用的数据及结论必须与工作簿一致。）

仅收集上述文件名对应的文件。即使文件内容正确，若写入其他位置或使用其他名称，也得零分。

materials.text:
Control notes and supplied policy
Gildenhall Freight — Vellumstone Laboratories binding-authority book
Supplied policy excerpt (internal fiduciary control): The trust position is reviewed each business day. A confirmed, irrevocable carrier payment may be considered together with the corresponding liability release when assessing whether the position is supported. Apparent deficits caused by bank posting and later liability release should be investigated, not ignored; unresolved or excess deficits are escalated.
12 May 2025 — Petra Alcantara, Finance Manager
The bank debit can post before the liability release appears in the ledger. Ordinary scheduled remittances normally cure on the next supplied business day. I need a daily exception view that separates those timing dips from a true shortage.
28 May 2025 — Ruben Vanterpool, Treasury Operations
For the ramp, two underlying risks are packed into each authority-intake pack. Please convert packs to risks before applying the average trust premium. Expected-clear / settlement dates were not recorded for a small early subset; use one consistent observed lag if you choose to impute, or exclude those records from calibration.
06 June 2025 — Jarek Thackeray, Binding Authority Lead
The external partner will want a clear owner. Petra should review the daily control; Treasury Operations investigates bank posting and remittance evidence. Genuine alerts go to me and Ruben for same-day triage and, if unresolved, examination reporting.
18 July 2025 — Petra Alcantara
A posted-position reading can retain the posted liability, show a timing allowance only for confirmed irrevocable remittances, and test cure on the next supplied business day. An effective-position reading can reduce liability on the effective remittance date. Either is workable if documented and applied consistently.
Examination milestone
The state insurance department examination is expected on 31 March 2026. Reporting audience: Jarek Thackeray and Ruben Vanterpool, with Vellumstone Laboratories as the external binding-authority partner.

gold.text:
Premium-trust compliance assessment
Gildenhall Freight | Vellumstone Laboratories binding-authority book

Prepared for Jarek Thackeray and Ruben Vanterpool • 24 August 2025


Purpose and control design
The proposed daily control uses a posted-position interpretation. It keeps the posted fiduciary liability visible, then
adds a timing allowance only for a confirmed irrevocable carrier remittance while its liability release is not yet posted.
The tested position is cleared trust balance minus posted liability plus that allowance. A genuine alert opens when
the tested position is less than -$25,000; exactly -$25,000 is not an alert. A negative raw gap with supported
next-business-day cure is labelled timing-only. An uncured timing case is escalated, and any residual beyond the
allowance remains a genuine alert.

Why this avoids false alarms
The source history shows scheduled carrier debits posting before the corresponding liability release. A raw
balance-minus-liability rule would therefore alarm routinely on remittance days. The allowance removes only that
documented timing amount; it does not suppress a non-remittance deficiency or a residual deficit larger than the
remittance.

          Historical result                                      Value
          Monitoring days                                                                                          87
          Genuine-alert days                                                                                        2
          Aggregate genuine shortfall                                                                      $100,000
          Worst tested position                                                            $-55,000 on 2025-06-10

The two validation episodes are the 10 June non-remittance deficiency and the 27 August residual shortfall on a remittance day.
Ordinary confirmed remittance timing is not counted as genuine.
 Scenario outlook through the examination date
Forecasts use the supplied weekday calendar from 1 September 2025 through 31 March 2026. Each intake pack
contains two underlying risks; premium is converted before the cash and liability rollforward. The same $25,000
tested-position rule is applied in every case.
    Case                   Underlying units    Peak liability         Min tested          Alerts       First alert

    Base plan                          3,040             $1,746,240            $30,000             0   No alert

    Accelerated intake                 4,864             $2,096,416            $30,000             0   No alert

    Stress / slower cure               6,688             $2,529,302           $-672,240        141     2025-09-16




Implementation recommendation
Implement the posted-position monitor immediately. It is transparent to the external partner, preserves evidence of
bank-versus-ledger timing, and still caught both seeded genuine deficiencies in the short history. Petra Alcantara
owns the daily review; Treasury Operations investigates bank posting and remittance support. Genuine alerts are
sent to Jarek Thackeray and Ruben Vanterpool for same-day triage and examination reporting. Timing-only rows are
documented and closed when the supplied cure evidence arrives.

Limitations and review point
The book is ramping quickly and the supplied history covers only four months, with no established seasonality.
Missing settlement fields are left blank and excluded from calibration; forecasts are scenario illustrations, not
certainty. Review the threshold weekly during the ramp and formally recalibrate at the 31 March 2026 examination
milestone or sooner after a materially larger experience base.

sheets.name: Daily Monitor
rows: Gildenhall Freight — Premium Trust Exception Monitor
Posted-position interpretation | Threshold: tested position < $25,000 below zero

sheets.name: Scenario Outlook
rows: Same posted-position test and $25,000 threshold applied to every case.

sheets.name: Method
rows: Posted-position. Retain posted fiduciary liability; add a timing allowance only for confirmed irrevocable carrier remittances while release is not yet posted. Test cure on the next supplied business day. This preserves visibility of timing while preventing routine false alarms.
Cleared trust balance minus posted fiduciary liability.
Raw gap + timing allowance. Confirmed, pending, cancelled or blank-status remittances receive no allowance.
Genuine alert when tested position < -$25,000. At exactly -$25,000 the row is not an alert. Timing-only rows are negative raw gaps with supported next-business-day cure; uncured timing is escalated.

Observed ordinary timing-only dips are normalized by the allowance; genuine validation cases are -$55,000 (10 Jun, non-remittance) and a residual -$45,000 on 27 Aug. A $25,000 threshold sits between routine timing and genuine deficiencies.
Blank expected-clear / settlement fields remain blank and are excluded from calibration. No unsupported dates are invented. Projection uses each case's supplied cure-lag assumption.
Each intake pack contains 2 underlying risks (Ruben, 28 May). Underlying units = packs × 2; premium = units × supplied average trust premium.
Weekdays only from 1 Sep 2025 through 31 Mar 2026. Deposits follow each case rhythm; remittances follow cadence and percentage; cash and liability roll forward from the final historical row.
Petra Alcantara reviews daily; Treasury Operations investigates posting/remittance evidence. Genuine alerts go to Jarek Thackeray and Ruben Vanterpool for same-day triage and examination reporting.
Implement the posted-position monitor now, with a weekly calibration review during the ramp and formal recalibration at the examination milestone or after a materially larger experience base.

original.evidence: PDF page count

criteria.description: `Daily Monitor`的历史部分始于实质性源表中的第一个有日期的观测值，止于其最后一个有日期的观测值，边界日期完全匹配（容差±0天）。
criteria.evidence: 每日监控器日期和源历史表
criteria.grader_hint: 在横幅和边距之后定位真正的每日表，然后比较最小和最大日期。

original.criterion: The historical portion of `Daily Monitor` begins on the first dated observation in the substantive source table and ends on its last dated observation, with boundary dates matching exactly (tolerance ±0 days).
original.evidence: Daily Monitor dates and source historical table
original.grader_hint: Locate the true daily table after its banner and gutters, then compare minimum and maximum dates.

criteria.description: 对于每个标记为监控业务日的源日期，恰好有一条历史记录，没有额外日期，计数容差为±0条记录。
criteria.evidence: 每日监控器、源日期和业务日指示符
criteria.grader_hint: 将历史监控日期集合与带有监控日标识的源日期集合进行比较。

original.criterion: There is exactly one historical monitor record for every source date marked as a monitoring business day, with no extra dates and count tolerance ±0 records.
original.evidence: Daily Monitor, source dates and business-day indicator
original.grader_hint: Compare the set of historical monitor dates with the set of source dates carrying the monitoring-day designation.

criteria.description: 每个历史已清算信托余额与相应的源金额一致，误差在±$1以内。
criteria.evidence: 每日监控器已清算余额和源每日表
criteria.grader_hint: 按日期连接记录并比较已清算余额字段。

original.criterion: Each historical cleared trust balance agrees with the corresponding source amount to ±$1.
original.evidence: Daily Monitor cleared balance and source daily table
original.grader_hint: Join records by date and compare the cleared-balance field.

criteria.description: 在任何明确识别的时间调整之前，每个历史受托责任或要求与相应的源金额一致，误差在±$1以内。
criteria.evidence: 每日监控器责任字段和源每日表
criteria.grader_hint: 按日期连接并比较未调整的责任度量；不要将单独显示的调整视为不匹配。

original.criterion: Each historical fiduciary liability or requirement agrees with the corresponding source amount to ±$1 before any clearly identified timing adjustment.
original.evidence: Daily Monitor liability fields and source daily table
original.grader_hint: Join by date and compare the unadjusted liability measure; do not treat a separately shown adjustment as a mismatch.

criteria.description: 确认的承运人汇款金额及其相关的发起、银行入账或责任释放日期是从源记录中转录或推导出来的，没有日期偏移，容差分别为±$1和±0天。
criteria.evidence: 每日监控器汇款字段、源每日表和备注
criteria.grader_hint: 检查所有具有确认汇款的源日期，并比较金额和时间属性。

original.criterion: Confirmed carrier-remittance amounts and their relevant initiation, bank-posting or liability-release dates are transcribed or derived from the source records without a date shift, with tolerances of ±$1 and ±0 days.
original.evidence: Daily Monitor remittance fields, source daily table and notes
original.grader_hint: Check all source dates with confirmed remittances and compare both amount and timing attributes.

criteria.description: 监控器使用的历史保费收据或存款与实质性源表按日期一致，误差在±$1以内。
criteria.evidence: 每日监控器存款字段和源每日表
criteria.grader_hint: 按日期比较存款，排除位于真正源表旁边的无关表格。

original.criterion: Historical premium receipts or deposits used by the monitor agree with the substantive source table to ±$1 by date.
original.evidence: Daily Monitor deposit fields and source daily table
original.grader_hint: Compare deposits by date, excluding the unrelated table positioned beside the true source table.

criteria.description: 对于每个历史日期，未调整的每日信托缺口等于已清算信托余额减去未调整受托责任，误差在±$1以内。
criteria.evidence: 每日监控器余额、责任和原始缺口字段
criteria.grader_hint: 根据显示输入重新计算每个历史行的原始缺口。

original.criterion: The unadjusted daily trust gap equals cleared trust balance minus unadjusted fiduciary liability for every historical date, to ±$1.
original.evidence: Daily Monitor balance, liability and raw-gap fields
original.grader_hint: Recalculate the raw gap from displayed inputs for each historical row.

criteria.description: 对汇款与责任时间不匹配的选定处理方式是支持政策和备注所支持的两种解读之一：针对确认不可撤销汇款的有效头寸处理方式，或针对具有单独识别的时间宽限和提供业务日补救测试的入账头寸处理方式。
criteria.evidence: 每日监控器计算、方法和提供的政策/备注
criteria.grader_hint: 如果可识别地实施，则接受任一支持的解读；不要求参考解决方案的首选选项。

original.criterion: The selected treatment of the remittance-versus-liability timing mismatch is one of the two readings supported by the supplied policy and notes: an effective-position treatment for confirmed irrevocable remittances, or a posted-position treatment with a separately identified timing allowance and supplied-business-day cure test.
original.evidence: Daily Monitor calculations, Method and supplied policy/notes
original.grader_hint: Accept either supported reading if it is recognizably implemented; do not require the reference solution's preferred option.

criteria.description: 在有效头寸处理方式下，只有确认不可撤销的汇款减少受测责任；在入账头寸处理方式下，只有这些汇款支持时间宽限。在任何一种情况下，金额与源数据一致，误差在±$1以内。
criteria.evidence: 每日监控器调整后字段和源汇款状态
criteria.grader_hint: 确定选定的解读方式，然后测试待处理、取消或其他未确认的项目是否未获得调整。

original.criterion: Under an effective-position treatment, only confirmed irrevocable remittances reduce the tested liability; under a posted-position treatment, only those remittances support the timing allowance. In either case, amounts agree with the source to ±$1.
original.evidence: Daily Monitor adjusted fields and source remittance status
original.grader_hint: Identify the chosen reading, then test that pending, cancelled or otherwise unconfirmed items do not receive the adjustment.

criteria.description: 在每个历史日期，标准化或受测的每日头寸与披露的解释在算术上一致，误差在±$1以内。
criteria.evidence: 每日监控器受测头寸字段和方法
criteria.grader_hint: 在整个历史期间重新执行选定的调整或时间宽限计算。

original.criterion: The normalized or tested daily position is arithmetically consistent with the disclosed interpretation on every historical date, to ±$1.
original.evidence: Daily Monitor tested-position fields and Method
original.grader_hint: Reperform the chosen adjustment or timing-allowance calculation across the historical period.

criteria.description: 在提供材料所述时间内得到补救的普通确认汇款日不被归类为真实的受托短缺警报。
criteria.evidence: 每日监控器状态、源汇款/释放日期和备注
criteria.grader_hint: 使用源确认的仅时间案例并验证没有一个案例被赋予最终的真实短缺状态。

original.criterion: Ordinary confirmed remittance days that cure within the timing described in the supplied materials are not classified as genuine fiduciary-shortfall alerts.
original.evidence: Daily Monitor status, source remittance/release dates and notes
original.grader_hint: Use the source-confirmed timing-only cases and verify that none receives the final genuine-shortfall status.

criteria.description: 源植入的非汇款缺陷被归类为真实警报，而不是被汇款宽限或时间例外吸收。
criteria.evidence: 每日监控器状态和源每日活动
criteria.grader_hint: 定位不归因于确认承运人汇款的不利事件并检查其最终状态。

original.criterion: The source-seeded non-remittance deficiency is classified as a genuine alert rather than being absorbed by a remittance allowance or timing exception.
original.evidence: Daily Monitor status and source daily activity
original.grader_hint: Locate the adverse episode not attributable to a confirmed carrier remittance and inspect its final status.

criteria.description: 源植入的汇款日案例，其残余缺陷超过支持的时间金额，仍保持为真实警报。
criteria.evidence: 每日监控器受测头寸和源汇款日案例
criteria.grader_hint: 确认实现方式不会仅仅因为发生了汇款就抑制整天。

original.criterion: The source-seeded remittance-day case whose residual deficiency exceeds the supported timing amount remains a genuine alert.
original.evidence: Daily Monitor tested position and source remittance-day case
original.grader_hint: Confirm that the implementation does not suppress the whole day merely because a remittance occurred.

criteria.description: 未在适用的下一个提供业务日内得到补救的时间例外根据披露规则升级，日期容差为±0个业务日。
criteria.evidence: 每日监控器状态序列、源业务日历和方法
criteria.grader_hint: 对于未解决的时间案例，将升级日期与提供的业务日序列进行比较。

original.criterion: A timing exception that does not cure by the applicable next supplied business day is escalated under the disclosed rule, with date tolerance ±0 business days.
original.evidence: Daily Monitor status sequence, source business-day calendar and Method
original.grader_hint: For the unresolved timing case, compare the escalation date with the supplied business-day sequence.

criteria.description: 空白的结算或预期清算字段与已知日期保持可区分；没有呈现任何源不支持的具体日期作为观察事实。
criteria.evidence: 每日监控器、源空白和方法
criteria.grader_hint: 追踪每个缺少时间字段的源记录并检查相应监控器字段的表示方式。

original.criterion: Blank settlement or expected-clear fields remain distinguishable from known dates; no specific date unsupported by the sources is presented as observed fact.
original.evidence: Daily Monitor, source blanks and Method
original.grader_hint: Trace every source record with an absent timing field and inspect how the corresponding monitor field is represented.

criteria.description: 如果假设缺失的时间值，则该假设一致地应用于所有可比记录；如果将它们从校准中排除，则一致地排除所有可比记录。
criteria.evidence: 每日监控器计算和方法
criteria.grader_hint: 对具有相同缺失字段条件的记录进行分组并验证单一声明的处理方式。

original.criterion: If missing timing values are assumed, the assumption is applied consistently to all comparable records; if they are excluded from calibration, all comparable records are excluded consistently.
original.evidence: Daily Monitor calculations and Method
original.grader_hint: Group records with the same missing-field condition and verify a single stated treatment.

criteria.description: 来自真正源表旁边无关表的数值不进入余额、责任、存款、汇款、阈值或预测。
criteria.evidence: 工作簿公式或显示输入和无关源表
criteria.grader_hint: 追踪计算输入并在输出中搜索相邻无关表特有的数字或文本值。

original.criterion: Values from the unrelated table beside the real source table do not enter balances, liabilities, deposits, remittances, thresholds or forecasts.
original.evidence: Workbook formulas or displayed inputs and unrelated source table
original.grader_hint: Trace calculation inputs and search outputs for numeric or textual values unique to the adjacent unrelated table.

criteria.description: 真实警报日的历史计数等于满足提交规则的监控日期数量，容差为±0天。
criteria.evidence: 每日监控器状态和提交规则
criteria.grader_hint: 将提交规则重新应用于每个历史受测头寸并比较 resulting 计数。

original.criterion: The historical count of genuine-alert days equals the number of monitor dates satisfying the submitted rule, with tolerance ±0 days.
original.evidence: Daily Monitor status and submitted rule
original.grader_hint: Reapply the submitted rule to each historical tested position and compare the resulting count.

criteria.description: 任何显示的历史汇总短缺金额等于由提交规则选择的真实负受测头寸幅度的总和，误差在±$1以内。
criteria.evidence: 每日监控器详细行和摘要
criteria.grader_hint: 根据带有真实警报状态的行重新计算汇总；如果没有显示此类汇总，则不得分。

original.criterion: Any displayed historical aggregate shortfall amount equals the sum of the magnitudes of genuine negative tested positions selected by the submitted rule, to ±$1.
original.evidence: Daily Monitor detailed rows and summary
original.grader_hint: Recalculate the aggregate from rows carrying the genuine-alert status; if no such aggregate is displayed, award no credit.

criteria.description: 最差历史受测头寸等于`Daily Monitor`中最小的受测每日头寸，误差在±$1以内，且其日期与底层行匹配，容差为±0天。
criteria.evidence: 每日监控器行和摘要
criteria.grader_hint: 取最小受测头寸值并将金额和相关日期与显示的摘要进行比较。

original.criterion: The worst historical tested position equals the minimum tested daily position in `Daily Monitor`, to ±$1, and its date matches the underlying row with tolerance ±0 days.
original.evidence: Daily Monitor rows and summary
original.grader_hint: Take the minimum tested-position value and compare both amount and associated date with the displayed summary.

criteria.description: 每个历史行都有一个可理解的最终状态，至少区分正常、仅时间和真实警报结果，而没有矛盾的同步状态。
criteria.evidence: 每日监控器状态字段
criteria.grader_hint: 检查所有历史记录是否有空白、相互矛盾或语义模糊的最终状态。

original.criterion: Every historical row has an intelligible final state that distinguishes at least normal, timing-only and genuine-alert outcomes without contradictory simultaneous states.
original.evidence: Daily Monitor status fields
original.grader_hint: Inspect all historical records for blank, mutually contradictory or semantically ambiguous final statuses.

criteria.description: 监控器陈述了一个数值警报阈值或等效的可执行公式，并且任何显示的美元阈值可以根据陈述的方法和源观测值重新计算，误差在±$1以内。
criteria.evidence: 每日监控器、方法和源数据
criteria.grader_hint: 按照描述的校准使用源观测值并与工作簿阈值进行比较。

original.criterion: The monitor states a numeric alert threshold or an equivalently executable formula, and any displayed dollar threshold can be recomputed to ±$1 from the stated method and source observations.
original.evidence: Daily Monitor, Method and source data
original.grader_hint: Follow the described calibration using source observations and compare with the workbook threshold.

criteria.description: 阈值校准不得将经来源确认的正常汇款时间低谷视为真实的不良观察结果。
criteria.evidence: 方法、校准支持及仅涉及时间的源日期
criteria.grader_hint: 检查用于设定阈值的观察结果，并验证仅涉及时间的原始差距是否已按披露方式归一化或排除。

original.criterion: The threshold calibration does not treat source-confirmed ordinary remittance timing dips as genuine adverse observations.
original.evidence: Method, calibration support and source timing-only dates
original.grader_hint: Inspect the observations used to set the threshold and verify that timing-only raw gaps are normalized or excluded as disclosed.

criteria.description: 校准后的规则仍具有足够的灵敏度，能够对用于验证的每一个经来源确认的真实缺陷发出警报。
criteria.evidence: 阈值、每日监控器及经来源确认的缺陷案例
criteria.grader_hint: 在选定的时间处理方式之后，对每个真实案例应用该阈值。

original.criterion: The calibrated rule remains sensitive enough to alert on every source-confirmed genuine deficiency used for validation.
original.evidence: Threshold, Daily Monitor and source-confirmed deficiency cases
original.grader_hint: Apply the threshold to each genuine case after the chosen timing treatment.

criteria.description: 规则的比较方向和边界处理是明确的且一致实施的，包括恰好处于阈值±$1容差范围内的观察结果。
criteria.evidence: 方法及每日监控器公式/状态
criteria.grader_hint: 确定规则使用的是“小于”还是“小于等于”，并确认公式遵循所述的边界条件。

original.criterion: The rule's comparison direction and boundary treatment are explicit and implemented consistently, including observations exactly at the threshold to tolerance ±$1.
original.evidence: Method and Daily Monitor formulas/statuses
original.grader_hint: Determine whether the rule uses less than or less than-or-equal and confirm that formulas follow the stated boundary.

criteria.description: 所选阈值对于快速增长的业务组合而言在专业上是可辩护的：它与提供的观察结果或规模度量挂钩，而非一个无解释的整数。
criteria.evidence: 方法、历史分析及源增长信息
criteria.grader_hint: 评估另一位财务经理是否能理解为何此阈值与业务组合及观察到的时间行为相称。

original.criterion: The chosen threshold is professionally defensible for a rapidly growing book: it is tied to the supplied observations or scale measure rather than being an unexplained round number.
original.evidence: Method, historical analysis and source growth information
original.grader_hint: Assess whether another finance manager could understand why this threshold is proportionate to the book and the observed timing behavior.

criteria.description: 除明确提供或披露的情景输入外，在每个前瞻情景中使用的实质性警报测试与在历史日期上使用的相同。
criteria.evidence: 每日监控器规则、情景展望计算及方法
criteria.grader_hint: 比较前瞻警报公式与历史公式，并识别任何未解释的变化。

original.criterion: The same substantive alert test used on historical dates is used in every forward scenario, apart from scenario inputs expressly supplied or disclosed.
original.evidence: Daily Monitor rule, Scenario Outlook calculations and Method
original.grader_hint: Compare the forward alert formula with the historical formula and identify any unexplained change.

criteria.description: 前瞻展望从最后一个历史源日期之后开始，到提供的审查日期结束，端点容差为±0天。
criteria.evidence: 情景展望、源历史期间及提供的审查日期
criteria.grader_hint: 将情景日期边界与最终历史日期和审查日期进行比较。

original.criterion: The forward outlook begins after the last historical source date and ends on the supplied examination date, with endpoint tolerance ±0 days.
original.evidence: Scenario Outlook, source historical period and supplied examination date
original.grader_hint: Compare scenario date boundaries with the final historical date and examination date.

criteria.description: 源中出现的每个命名展望案例均出现在`Scenario Outlook`中，且没有遗漏任何必需案例。
criteria.evidence: 情景展望及源展望案例标签
criteria.grader_hint: 比较源中的情景名称集合与交付物中的情景名称集合。

original.criterion: Each named outlook case in the source appears in `Scenario Outlook`, and no required case is omitted.
original.evidence: Scenario Outlook and source outlook-case labels
original.grader_hint: Compare the set of scenario names in the source with those in the deliverable.

criteria.description: 每个情景包含在提供的日历中标记为预测监控工作日的每一个日期，计数容差为±0个日期。
criteria.evidence: 情景展望及提供的工作日日历
criteria.grader_hint: 分别为每个情景比较日期集合。

original.criterion: Each scenario includes every date marked as a projected monitoring business day in the supplied calendar, with count tolerance ±0 dates.
original.evidence: Scenario Outlook and supplied business-day calendar
original.grader_hint: Compare date sets separately for each scenario.

criteria.description: 初始预测信托余额锚定于最终历史清算余额，仅针对清晰披露且有源支持的过渡进行调整，误差范围为±$1。
criteria.evidence: 情景展望初始行、每日监控器最终行及方法
criteria.grader_hint: 将最终历史余额桥接至第一个预测余额。

original.criterion: The opening projected trust balance is anchored to the final historical cleared balance, adjusted only for a clearly disclosed source-supported transition, to ±$1.
original.evidence: Scenario Outlook opening row, Daily Monitor final row and Method
original.grader_hint: Bridge the final historical balance to the first projected balance.

criteria.description: 预测授权量使用利益相关者材料中的包大小事实，将源数据包转换为底层风险或政策单位，单位数量容差为±1个底层单位。
criteria.evidence: 情景展望量计算、源展望表及利益相关者备注
criteria.grader_hint: 重新计算底层量为数据包乘以每包记录的内容；将一个数据包视为一个风险是不合格的。

original.criterion: Forecast authority volume converts source packs into the underlying risk or policy units using the pack-size fact in the stakeholder materials, with unit-count tolerance ±1 underlying unit.
original.evidence: Scenario Outlook volume calculation, source outlook table and stakeholder notes
original.grader_hint: Recalculate underlying volume as packs multiplied by the documented contents per pack; treating one pack as one risk fails.

criteria.description: 预测保费量等于转换后的底层单位乘以适用的提供保费假设，误差范围为±$1。
criteria.evidence: 情景展望及源情景假设
criteria.grader_hint: 在应用所需的数据包转换后，重新执行保费计算。

original.criterion: Projected premium volume equals converted underlying units multiplied by the applicable supplied premium assumption, to ±$1.
original.evidence: Scenario Outlook and source scenario assumptions
original.grader_hint: Reperform the premium calculation after applying the required pack conversion.

criteria.description: 每个情景的总转换底层量等于其每日转换量之和，容差为±1个底层单位。
criteria.evidence: 情景展望明细及情景摘要
criteria.grader_hint: 在每个命名情景内汇总每日转换单位。

original.criterion: The total converted underlying volume for each scenario equals the sum of its daily converted volume, with tolerance ±1 underlying unit.
original.evidence: Scenario Outlook detail and scenario summaries
original.grader_hint: Sum daily converted units within each named scenario.

criteria.description: 预测存款日期应用源情景所述的存款节奏或对缺失时间字段的明确披露处理方式，容差为±0个提供的工作日。
criteria.evidence: 情景展望、源情景输入及方法
criteria.grader_hint: 使用提供的工作日日历追踪预测保费生成至信托存款的过程。

original.criterion: Projected deposit dates apply the source scenario's stated deposit rhythm or the explicitly disclosed treatment of an absent timing field, with tolerance ±0 supplied business days.
original.evidence: Scenario Outlook, source scenario inputs and Method
original.grader_hint: Trace forecast premium generation to trust deposits using the supplied business-day calendar.

criteria.description: 预测承运人汇款遵循为每个展望案例提供的节奏和金额基础，容差分别为±0个提供的工作日和±$1。
criteria.evidence: 情景展望及源汇款假设
criteria.grader_hint: 重新计算每个情景的预期汇款日期和金额。

original.criterion: Projected carrier remittances follow the cadence and amount basis supplied for each outlook case, with tolerances of ±0 supplied business days and ±$1.
original.evidence: Scenario Outlook and source remittance assumptions
original.grader_hint: Recalculate expected remittance dates and amounts for every scenario.

criteria.description: 预测受托责任从前一天向前滚动，使用展望中显示的预测保费和减少责任的事件，误差范围为±$1。
criteria.evidence: 情景展望每日责任滚动
criteria.grader_hint: 对样本重新执行逐日责任桥接，并调节情景总额。

original.criterion: Projected fiduciary liability rolls forward from the prior day using the forecast premium and liability-reducing events shown in the outlook, to ±$1.
original.evidence: Scenario Outlook daily liability rollforward
original.grader_hint: Reperform the day-to-day liability bridge for a sample and reconcile scenario totals.

criteria.description: 预测清算信托余额从前一天向前滚动，使用预测清算存款、汇款及任何其他有源支持的现金事件，误差范围为±$1。
criteria.evidence: 情景展望每日余额滚动
criteria.grader_hint: 重新执行现金滚动，并确保不出现无支持的平衡金额。

original.criterion: Projected cleared trust balance rolls forward from the prior day using projected cleared deposits, remittances and any other source-supported cash events, to ±$1.
original.evidence: Scenario Outlook daily balance rollforward
original.grader_hint: Reperform the cash rollforward and ensure no unsupported balancing amounts appear.

criteria.description: 预测测试头寸一致地应用选定的历史汇款时间解释，误差范围为±$1。
criteria.evidence: 情景展望测试头寸字段及方法
criteria.grader_hint: 使用选定的解释重新计算预测测试头寸。

original.criterion: Projected tested positions apply the selected historical remittance-timing interpretation consistently, to ±$1.
original.evidence: Scenario Outlook tested-position fields and Method
original.grader_hint: Recompute projected tested positions using the chosen interpretation.

criteria.description: 对于每个情景，显示的最低测试头寸等于其每日预测测试头寸的最小值，误差范围为±$1。
criteria.evidence: 情景展望明细及摘要
criteria.grader_hint: 按情景计算最小值并与摘要进行比较。

original.criterion: For each scenario, the displayed minimum tested position equals the minimum of its daily projected tested positions to ±$1.
original.evidence: Scenario Outlook detail and summary
original.grader_hint: Calculate the minimum by scenario and compare with the summary.

criteria.description: 对于每个情景，显示的真实警报天数等于满足提交警报规则的预测日期数量，容差为±0天。
criteria.evidence: 情景展望每日状态及摘要
criteria.grader_hint: 按情景重新应用规则并统计警报日期。

original.criterion: For each scenario, the displayed genuine-alert day count equals the number of projected dates satisfying the submitted alert rule, with tolerance ±0 days.
original.evidence: Scenario Outlook daily statuses and summary
original.grader_hint: Reapply the rule by scenario and count alert dates.

criteria.description: 对于至少有一个预测警报的每个情景，显示的首次警报日期等于满足规则的第一个日期，容差为±0天；无警报的情景以不虚构日期的方式表示。
criteria.evidence: 情景展望明细及摘要
criteria.grader_hint: 查找每个情景的最早警报日期并检查无警报的表示形式。

original.criterion: For each scenario with at least one projected alert, the displayed first-alert date equals the first date satisfying the rule, with tolerance ±0 days; scenarios with no alert are represented without an invented date.
original.evidence: Scenario Outlook detail and summary
original.grader_hint: Find the earliest alert date per scenario and inspect no-alert representations.

criteria.description: 任何显示的预测峰值受托责任等于该情景的最大每日预测责任，误差范围为±$1。
criteria.evidence: 情景展望明细及摘要
criteria.grader_hint: 从每日责任序列中获取情景最大值。

original.criterion: Any displayed projected peak fiduciary liability equals the maximum daily projected liability for that scenario, to ±$1.
original.evidence: Scenario Outlook detail and summary
original.grader_hint: Take the scenario maximum from the daily liability series.

criteria.description: 情景排序和比较结论遵循计算结果；被描述为具有更大短缺敞口的情景并非在所有显示的风险度量上都表现更好。
criteria.evidence: 情景展望比较及PDF讨论
criteria.grader_hint: 将定性排名与最低头寸、警报次数及首次警报时机进行比较。

original.criterion: Scenario ordering and comparative conclusions follow the calculated results; a scenario described as having greater shortfall exposure is not better on every displayed risk measure.
original.evidence: Scenario Outlook comparison and PDF discussion
original.grader_hint: Compare qualitative rankings with minimum positions, alert counts and first-alert timing.

criteria.description: `Method`工作表通过文件名标识两个提供的源文件。
criteria.evidence: 方法工作表
criteria.grader_hint: 在方法工作表中搜索两个精确的参考文件名。

original.criterion: The `Method` sheet identifies both supplied source files by filename.
original.evidence: Method sheet
original.grader_hint: Search the Method sheet for both exact reference filenames.

criteria.description: `Method`工作表清楚说明了选择了哪种有支持的汇款和责任时间解释，并解释了为何它适用于此监控器。
criteria.evidence: 方法工作表及提供的政策/备注
criteria.grader_hint: 评估选择是否是深思熟虑的、基于源的，并且无需逆向工程公式即可理解。

original.criterion: The `Method` sheet clearly states which supported interpretation of remittance and liability timing was selected and explains why it is appropriate for this monitor.
original.evidence: Method sheet and supplied policy/notes
original.grader_hint: Assess whether the selection is deliberate, source-grounded and understandable without reverse-engineering formulas.

criteria.description: `Method` 表披露了对不存在沉降或预期清晰区域的处理，包括是否假设或排除它们以及对校准或投影的影响。
criteria.evidence: 方法表和源空白
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找与源中实际差距相关的明确的缺失字段政策。

original.criterion: The `Method` sheet discloses the treatment of absent settlement or expected-clear fields, including whether they were assumed or excluded and the effect on calibration or projection.
original.evidence: Method sheet and source blanks
original.grader_hint: Look for an explicit missing-field policy tied to the actual gaps in the source.

criteria.description: `Method` 表解释了包到基础单元的转换，并使用与利益相关者材料一致的术语。
criteria.evidence: 方法表、来源展望假设和利益相关者说明
criteria.grader_hint: 确认读者可以重现单位转换，并且不会将包误认为个别风险。

original.criterion: The `Method` sheet explains the pack-to-underlying-unit conversion and uses terminology consistent with the stakeholder materials.
original.evidence: Method sheet, source outlook assumptions and stakeholder notes
original.grader_hint: Confirm that a reader could reproduce the unit conversion and would not mistake packs for individual risks.

criteria.description: 该方法文档足够清晰，可供另一位财务分析师从提供的文件中重现测试的头寸、阈值和警报状态。
criteria.evidence: 方法表和工作簿计算
criteria.grader_hint: 判断再现性而不是写作风格；无法解释的手动覆盖或不透明的常量应该失去信誉。

original.criterion: The method documentation is sufficiently clear for another finance analyst to reproduce the tested position, threshold and alert status from the supplied files.
original.evidence: Method sheet and workbook calculations
original.grader_hint: Judge reproducibility rather than writing style; unexplained manual overrides or opaque constants should lose credit.

criteria.description: PDF 准确地解释了为什么未调整的每日缺口会在普通汇款日产生误报，以及拟议的控制措施如何在不抑制真正缺陷的情况下避免这种结果。
criteria.evidence: 合规性评估、工作簿和提供的注释
criteria.grader_hint: 评估该解释是否区分了常规时间和实质性短缺并反映了实施的规则。

original.criterion: The PDF accurately explains why the unadjusted daily gap would create false alarms on ordinary remittance days and how the proposed control avoids that outcome without suppressing genuine deficiencies.
original.evidence: Compliance assessment, workbook and supplied notes
original.grader_hint: Assess whether the explanation distinguishes routine timing from substantive shortage and reflects the implemented rule.

criteria.description: PDF 解决了有限的历史窗口和缺乏既定季节性的限制，而不是提供确定的预测。
criteria.evidence: 合规性评估和来源期限
criteria.grader_hint: 寻找与斜坡书相关的实质性的、与决策相关的限制。

original.criterion: The PDF addresses the limited historical window and lack of established seasonality as a limitation rather than presenting the forecast as certain.
original.evidence: Compliance assessment and source period
original.grader_hint: Look for a material, decision-relevant limitation tied to the ramping book.

criteria.description: PDF 推荐了一种实施选项，并使用历史验证和场景比较（而不是仅使用偏好）来证明其合理性。
criteria.evidence: 合规性评估和工作簿结果
criteria.grader_hint: 该建议可以使用任一受支持的时序解释，但其基本原理必须遵循分析。

original.criterion: The PDF recommends one implementation option and justifies it using the historical validation and scenario comparison rather than preference alone.
original.evidence: Compliance assessment and workbook results
original.grader_hint: The recommendation may use either supported timing interpretation, but its rationale must follow the analysis.

criteria.description: 建议的响应流程从所提供的材料中指定了负责的角色，确定了及时调查或升级行动，并将仅处理计时案件与真正的警报区分开来。
criteria.evidence: 合规评估和利益相关者说明
criteria.grader_hint: 接受基于角色的所有权；不需要虚构的个人或不受支持的服务级别承诺。

original.criterion: The recommended response process names an accountable role from the supplied materials, identifies a prompt investigation or escalation action and distinguishes handling of timing-only cases from genuine alerts.
original.evidence: Compliance assessment and stakeholder notes
original.grader_hint: Accept role-based ownership; do not require an invented individual or unsupported service-level commitment.

criteria.description: 随着具有约束力的书籍的发展，PDF 提出了一个实际的重新校准或审查点，与积累的经验、卷的变化或提供的检查里程碑相关。
criteria.evidence: 合规性评估
criteria.grader_hint: 评估拟议的审查是否响应短期和非季节性历史记录。

original.criterion: The PDF proposes a practical recalibration or review point as the binding-authority book develops, tied to accumulated experience, volume change or the supplied examination milestone.
original.evidence: Compliance assessment
original.grader_hint: Assess whether the proposed review responds to the short and nonseasonal historical record.

criteria.description: PDF中规定的警报阈值或可执行阈值公式与工作簿规则实质上相同；任何共享的美元门槛都同意±$1。
criteria.evidence: 合规性评估和工作簿
criteria.grader_hint: 将 PDF 规则声明与方法进行比较并监控计算。

original.criterion: The alert threshold or executable threshold formula stated in the PDF is identical in substance to the workbook rule; any shared dollar threshold agrees to ±$1.
original.evidence: Compliance assessment and workbook
original.grader_hint: Compare the PDF rule statement with the Method and monitor calculations.

criteria.description: PDF 中引用的历史真实警报计数和任何历史最差位置金额或日期分别与工作簿一致，为 ±0 天、±$1 和 ±0 日期。
criteria.evidence: 合规评估及日常监控
criteria.grader_hint: 提取每个共享的历史人物并将其与工作簿进行比较。

original.criterion: The historical genuine-alert count and any historical worst-position amount or date quoted in the PDF agree with the workbook to ±0 days, ±$1 and ±0 date days respectively.
original.evidence: Compliance assessment and Daily Monitor
original.grader_hint: Extract each shared historical figure and compare it with the workbook.

spec.professional_context: Petra Alcantara is the finance manager responsible for preparing Gildenhall Freight’s daily premium-trust control for review by its external binding-authority partner, Vellumstone Laboratories, ahead of a state insurance department examination.
difficulty_sources: Distinguishing genuine fiduciary deficiencies from ordinary remittance and liability-posting timing
Selecting and disclosing one of two source-supported monitoring interpretations
Calibrating a threshold from a short, rapidly growing history without established seasonality
Handling absent settlement fields consistently without presenting assumptions as observed facts
Converting forecast intake packs into underlying risks before projecting premium and trust activity
Keeping the operating workbook and external assessment numerically and conceptually consistent

semantic_content: Provide a continuous four-month daily history for the new binding-authority book, including a supplied monitoring-business-day indicator, cleared trust balance, premium receipts, confirmed and unconfirmed carrier remittances, fiduciary liability, bank-posting timing and liability-release timing.
Provide a supplied future business-day calendar ending on a clearly identified spring examination date.

Provide several named outlook cases with book-intake volume, average trust premium per underlying risk, deposit rhythm, carrier-remittance cadence and any case-specific timing assumptions needed for a daily rollforward.
Make the final historical position capable of serving as the opening point for every scenario.
exact_layout_defects: Place a second, unrelated operational table beside the substantive daily table on the same sheet. Give one header in that unrelated table an embedded line break. Values unique to this table must be tempting but irrelevant to all premium-trust calculations.
Place a presentation banner above the substantive source material and leave gutter columns before it so the real table does not begin at A1.

Create a units trap in the outlook inputs: authority intake is recorded in packs, while a natural but incorrect reading would treat the figures as individual risks or policies. A stakeholder message in the DOCX must state how many underlying risks each pack contains. Choose a conversion factor and all literal values not appearing in the prompt.
prohibited_additional_defects: Do not seed duplicate substantive records.
Do not seed hidden rows or sheets, residual formula errors, inconsistent date formats, merged data cells, transposed sections, OCR-only content or unexplained floating-point noise.
Do not add any additional side tables, multiline substantive headers or unit ambiguities.

semantic_content: Include a short supplied jurisdictional or internal fiduciary-control policy excerpt establishing that the trust position is reviewed daily and that confirmed irrevocable carrier payments may be considered together with the corresponding liability release.

Include dated messages or interview notes from only the permitted people. They should explain that the bank debit can post before the liability release, that ordinary remittance timing normally cures on the next supplied business day and that unresolved or excess deficits still require escalation.

Support two defensible readings without declaring either mandatory: an effective-position reading that reduces liability for a confirmed irrevocable remittance on the effective date, and a posted-position reading that preserves the posted liability but identifies a timing allowance and tests cure on the next supplied business day.
State the pack-to-underlying-risk conversion naturally in a stakeholder message about expected intake, not in a purpose-built data dictionary.
Describe control ownership and expected escalation recipients at role level, and provide the examination milestone and reporting audience.

Mention that selected expected-clear or settlement fields were not recorded during the book's early ramp and that the team has used a consistent observed timing pattern, while leaving the practitioner free either to disclose and apply that assumption or to exclude those observations from calibration.

seeded_business_cases.ordinary_timing_cases: Create several scheduled carrier-remittance dates on which the raw cleared-balance-minus-posted-liability gap is negative solely because the bank debit precedes the documented liability release. Each must cure within the ordinary supplied-business-day timing.
seeded_business_cases.genuine_non_remittance_case: Create at least one negative tested position unrelated to a carrier remittance, documented by the activity and stakeholder records as an unresolved deficiency.
seeded_business_cases.genuine_remittance_day_case: Create at least one remittance date on which the deficit exceeds the confirmed remittance timing amount, so blanket suppression of all remittance days would miss a genuine residual shortfall.
seeded_business_cases.uncured_timing_case: Create a timing-coded case that remains unresolved beyond the ordinary next supplied business day and therefore must escalate under the posted-position reading.
seeded_business_cases.missing_fields: Leave expected-clear or settlement dates absent for a small subset of otherwise usable records. The source materials must support either applying one disclosed observed lag consistently or excluding those observations from calibration. Do not provide invented replacement dates as source facts.
seeded_business_cases.threshold_separation: Choose values so that, under either supported timing interpretation, a nonempty feasible threshold interval exists: all ordinary timing-only cases are on the non-alert side while every genuine deficiency is on the alert side. The cases should not all sit at the same amount.
seeded_business_cases.ramping_profile: Make exposure and premium volume rise materially across the history and diverge further across the named outlook cases, while avoiding any claim of established seasonality.

calculation_contract.historical_raw_gap: For each monitoring date, raw gap equals cleared trust balance minus unadjusted fiduciary liability.
calculation_contract.effective_position_option: For confirmed irrevocable remittances only, reduce the corresponding liability on the supported effective date; tested position equals cleared balance minus the resulting effective liability.
calculation_contract.posted_position_option: Retain posted liability, separately recognize a timing allowance no greater than the confirmed irrevocable remittance supported by the records and test whether the apparent deficit cures on the next supplied business day. Any excess or uncured amount remains alert-eligible.
calculation_contract.missing_timing_options: Either apply one documented observed settlement lag to all comparable missing values and label it as an assumption, or exclude all such records from threshold calibration while retaining them visibly in the history. Both approaches must remain internally consistent.
calculation_contract.threshold_gold: For each supported interpretation, derive the interval of thresholds that suppresses every confirmed ordinary timing-only case but catches every source-confirmed genuine deficiency. A solver-selected threshold within that interval passes if its comparison boundary is stated and its scale rationale is defensible.
calculation_contract.historical_alerts: A historical genuine-alert date is one whose tested position breaches the selected threshold after the chosen timing treatment. Timing-only and genuine-alert statuses must be mutually intelligible.
calculation_contract.unit_conversion: Underlying forecast volume equals source packs multiplied by the pack-size fact in the stakeholder message. Forecast premium equals converted underlying volume multiplied by the applicable supplied average trust premium.
calculation_contract.scenario_rollforward: Start after the last historical date using the final cleared balance and liability. For every supplied future monitoring business day and outlook case, apply the source deposit rhythm, remittance cadence and converted premium volume to roll forward trust cash and fiduciary liability.
calculation_contract.scenario_alerts: Apply the same selected timing interpretation and threshold rule used historically. Derive, per scenario, minimum tested position, peak liability, genuine-alert count and first alert date where one exists.
calculation_contract.cross_deliverable_values: The reference script must extract the workbook's selected threshold, historical genuine-alert count, worst tested position and date, and each scenario's alert count, first-alert date and minimum tested position, then compare every figure quoted in the PDF using the rubric tolerances.

output_vocabulary.source_location: The exact required output sheet names are stated in the request. Scenario names, pack terminology and role names are carried in the supplied files.
output_vocabulary.status_semantics: Do not require arbitrary local status codes. Any clear labels are acceptable if they distinguish normal, timing-only and genuine-alert outcomes and agree with the calculations.

gold_derivation.method: Use a reference script to locate the substantive table by its date and fiduciary fields rather than by A1 assumptions, ignore the unrelated adjacent table, parse the supplied policy facts and scenario inputs, and compute valid outputs under both accepted interpretations.
gold_derivation.professional_review: Have a finance-domain reviewer confirm that both accepted interpretations are supported by the supplied text, that the feasible threshold interval is nonempty, that the recommended option can be justified from the scenario results and that no rubric item requires external law or unstated local conventions.
gold_derivation.intended_verdict: A complete reference solution using either supported interpretation passes every credit item, while an obvious raw-gap rule, blanket remittance-day suppression, pack-as-unit forecast, undisclosed missing-field imputation or inconsistent PDF loses material credit.

original_instruction:
You are Petra Alcantara, the finance manager at Gildenhall Freight. The premium-trust balance for the Vellumstone Laboratories binding-authority book has been reviewed only at month-end since the book opened in May, and Jarek Thackeray wants a daily exception control operating before the spring examination. The complication is that the trust account dips whenever scheduled carrier remittances clear, while the corresponding liability release can appear later in the records, so a rule based on the unadjusted balance would create routine alarms that the team will stop taking seriously. Use `premium_trust_dossier.xlsx` for the daily activity, book-growth assumptions, remittance schedule and outlook cases, and use `control_notes_and_policy.docx` for the supplied policy text and the messages from the people who operate the process. Do not rely on law, rates or practices outside those attachments. Build `premium_trust_exception_monitor.xlsx` with sheets named `Daily Monitor`, `Scenario Outlook` and `Method`. It should show the historical daily position, distinguish timing-only exceptions from genuine shortfalls, state a usable threshold and alert rule, and project the rule through the examination date for every outlook case named in the dossier. Make any treatment of absent source fields, deposit timing and the remittance-versus-liability timing mismatch explicit; where the materials support more than one reading, choose one deliberately and apply it consistently rather than blending approaches. Also prepare `premium_trust_compliance_assessment.pdf`, no more than five pages, for Jarek and Ruben Vanterpool. Summarize the control design, historical result, projected outcomes, limitations and your recommended implementation option, including who should respond when an alert opens. The threshold, historical exceptions, scenario figures and recommendation in the assessment must agree with the workbook. Write both files into the top level of the working directory using exactly those filenames.

---

The files referred to above are in `references/`:

- `references/premium_trust_dossier.xlsx` — Daily premium-trust activity, remittance and liability timing records, binding-authority growth inputs, business-day calendar, examination date and named outlook cases.
- `references/control_notes_and_policy.docx` — Supplied jurisdictional policy excerpts and stakeholder messages about bank posting, liability release, missing settlement information, control ownership and reporting expectations.

Write your finished work to the **top level of the current working directory**, using exactly these filenames:

- `premium_trust_exception_monitor.xlsx` — Daily historical monitor, forward scenario outlook and documented monitoring method. (Must contain sheets named Daily Monitor, Scenario Outlook and Method; must apply one disclosed interpretation consistently and remain traceable to the supplied sources.)
- `premium_trust_compliance_assessment.pdf` — External-facing compliance assessment and implementation recommendation. (No more than five pages; figures and conclusions shared with the workbook must agree with it.)

Nothing outside those filenames is collected. A correct file written anywhere else, or under any other name, scores zero.
